title: MEDAL: A Framework for Benchmarking LLMs as Multilingual Open-Domain Dialogue Evaluators

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the performance of LLMs as both conversational chatbots and automated dialogue evaluators across six different languages (Chinese, English, French, German, Portuguese, Spanish) to identify cross-lingual performance disparities, error distributions, and evaluator correlation drops.

Conducting a head-to-head automated evaluation using an LLM judge to compare the cultural appropriateness and naturalness of dialogues natively generated in target languages against dialogues translated from English.
